source_policy: Use exact-title scholarly discovery, then verify venue and metadata against an official conference, publisher, DOI, or preprint record. Do not promote a search-result venue without primary-source confirmation.
dataset_policy: Record separately the datasets used for self-supervised or backbone pretraining and the datasets used for downstream evaluation. Preserve named benchmark suites and explicitly label unnamed private collections.

records.normalized_title: inter intra variant dual representations for self supervised video recognition

updates.method_description: Dual heads encode variation between videos and complementary variation among clips from the same video.

records.normalized_title: vimpac video pre training via masked token prediction and contrastive learning

updates.method_description: Blockwise masked prediction over VQ-VAE video tokens is combined with augmentation-free same-video contrastive learning.

records.normalized_title: watching too much television is good self supervised audio visual representation learning from movies and tv shows

updates.method_description: Audio-visual contrastive learning exploits long-form movies and television, including recurring characters, scenes, and sounds.
updates.dataset_notes: The training collection is described by media type rather than released as a named benchmark.
updates.audit_notes: Exact-title and author-record searches found no peer-reviewed version through the verification date.

records.normalized_title: temporally coherent embeddings for self supervised video representation learning

updates.method_description: A temporal-coherence metric loss keeps nearby frames close and temporally separated frames distinct in embedding space.
updates.dataset_notes: The conference retained the ICPR 2020 name but the IEEE proceedings record was published in 2021.

records.normalized_title: audio visual instance discrimination with cross modal agreement

updates.method_description: Cross-modal instance discrimination is extended with agreement-based mining of additional audio-video positives.

records.normalized_title: removing the background by adding the background towards background robust self supervised video representation learning

updates.method_description: A static frame is added to every frame of a clip and the original and distracted clips are aligned to suppress background dependence.

records.normalized_title: enhancing unsupervised video representation learning by decoupling the scene and the motion

updates.method_description: Spatial and temporal local disturbances form scene-broken and motion-broken views that explicitly separate appearance from motion.

records.normalized_title: seco exploring sequence supervision for unsupervised representation learning

updates.method_description: Frame, clip, and sequence-level contrastive tasks model spatial identity, video identity, and temporal order.
previous_titles: Seco: Exploring sequence supervision for unsupervised representation learning

records.normalized_title: enhancing self supervised video representation learning via multi level feature optimization

updates.method_description: Low-, mid-, and high-level feature objectives combine local contrast, temporal modeling, and global instance discrimination.

records.normalized_title: rspnet relative speed perception for unsupervised video representation learning

updates.method_description: Relative playback-speed prediction is paired with an appearance-focused task to retain motion and appearance cues.
previous_titles: RSPnet: Relative speed perception for unsupervised video representation learning

records.normalized_title: videomoco contrastive video representation learning with temporally adversarial examples

updates.method_description: An adversarial frame-drop generator creates temporally robust views and temporal decay reweights stale keys in the memory queue.
previous_titles: Videomoco: Contrastive video representation learning with temporally adversarial examples

records.normalized_title: on compositions of transformations in contrastive self supervised learning

updates.method_description: A generalized transformation framework specifies which spatial, temporal, audio, and text transformations should be invariant or distinctive.

records.normalized_title: unsupervised visual representation learning by tracking patches in video

updates.method_description: Synthetic moving patches create a tracking game in which a 3D encoder predicts each patch trajectory and scale.
updates.benchmark_text: UCF101, HMDB51, Something-Something V1, Something-Something V2

records.normalized_title: a large scale study on unsupervised spatiotemporal representation learning

updates.method_description: Image contrastive frameworks are generalized to video by encouraging features that persist across long temporal spans.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, Kinetics-600, Kinetics-700, UCF101, HMDB51, AVA

records.normalized_title: cocon cooperative contrastive learning

updates.method_description: Cooperating encoders exchange complementary positive targets so contrastive training captures both context and motion.

records.normalized_title: vatt transformers for multimodal self supervised learning from raw video audio and text

updates.method_description: Video, audio, and text transformers are trained end-to-end from raw signals with multimodal contrastive alignment.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, Kinetics-600, Kinetics-700, Moments in Time V1, ImageNet-1K, AudioSet, YouCook2, MSR-VTT

records.normalized_title: ascnet self supervised video representation learning with appearance speed consistency

updates.method_description: Appearance consistency aligns clips played at different speeds, while speed consistency aligns clips with different appearance at one speed.

records.normalized_title: self supervised visual learning by variable playback speeds prediction of a video

updates.method_description: The model predicts randomized forward, reverse, and mixed playback speeds with temporal group normalization.

records.normalized_title: self supervised video representation learning with meta contrastive network

updates.method_description: A meta-learning loop adapts the contrastive objective to generate more transferable video representations.

records.normalized_title: long short view feature decomposition via contrastive video representation learning

updates.method_description: Long and short views decompose stationary video attributes from non-stationary temporal attributes.

records.normalized_title: time equivariant contrastive video representation learning

updates.method_description: Representations are trained to transform predictably under temporal shifts while remaining invariant to content-preserving appearance changes.

records.normalized_title: self supervised video representation learning by context and motion decoupling

updates.method_description: Compressed-video keyframes supervise context matching and motion vectors supervise future-motion prediction.

records.normalized_title: unsupervised video representation learning by bidirectional feature prediction

updates.method_description: Past and future latent features are predicted jointly, with swapped temporal predictions forming hard negatives.

records.normalized_title: self supervised learning of compressed video representations

updates.method_description: I-frames, motion vectors, and residuals provide complementary self-supervision directly in the compressed-video domain.

records.normalized_title: spatiotemporal contrastive video representation learning

updates.method_description: Two temporally separated clips receive temporally consistent spatial augmentation and are contrasted as views of one video.

records.normalized_title: modist motion distillation for self supervised video representation learning

updates.method_description: An optical-flow teacher distills motion-sensitive targets into an RGB video encoder without flow at inference.
updates.audit_notes: Exact-title and author-record searches found no peer-reviewed version through the verification date.
previous_titles: Modist: Motion distillation for self-supervised video representation learning

records.normalized_title: broaden your views for self supervised video learning

updates.method_description: A short-view encoder predicts a momentum target from a much broader temporal view without negative samples.

records.normalized_title: vi2clr video and image for visual contrastive learning of representation

updates.method_description: Image and video batches share a contrastive encoder, transferring spatial appearance supervision into spatiotemporal learning.

records.normalized_title: contrast and order representations for video self supervised learning

updates.method_description: Instance contrast is combined with clip-order modeling so the embedding retains appearance and temporal sequence information.

records.normalized_title: motion augmented self training for video recognition at smaller scale

updates.method_description: A small labeled optical-flow teacher pseudo-labels a large unlabeled collection, then an RGB student learns with a multi-clip loss.
updates.dataset_notes: Kinetics-400 supplies unlabeled self-training video; the small target datasets train the motion teacher and evaluate transfer.

records.normalized_title: video contrastive learning with global context

updates.method_description: Segment-level positives capture global video context and temporal-order regularization preserves long-range sequence structure.

records.normalized_title: motion focused contrastive learning of video representations

updates.method_description: Optical flow guides tubelet sampling and aligns convolutional gradient maps with spatial and temporal motion patterns.

records.normalized_title: back to the future cycle encoding prediction for self supervised video representation learning

updates.method_description: Forward and backward temporal cycle encoders are trained so elapsed-time transitions remain predictable and reversible.

records.normalized_title: composable augmentation encoding for video representation learning

updates.method_description: Relative spatial and temporal augmentation parameters are encoded explicitly in the contrastive projection head.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, UCF101, HMDB51, Something-Something V2, Diving48

records.normalized_title: learning temporal dynamics from cycles in narrated video

updates.method_description: Vision and language dynamics predict forward and backward in time and are constrained to form invertible temporal cycles.

records.normalized_title: crossclr cross modal contrastive learning for multi modal video representations

updates.method_description: Cross-modal contrastive learning removes highly related false negatives using intra-modal similarity and aligns local and global embeddings.
previous_titles: Crossclr: Cross-modal contrastive learning for multi-modal video representations

records.normalized_title: watching the world go by representation learning from unlabeled videos

updates.method_description: Multi-frame, multi-positive noise-contrastive learning uses temporally related natural video views and a momentum memory bank.
updates.dataset_notes: R2V2 is the authors' Random Related Video Views collection; URL-based YouTube-8M and Kinetics-400 collections are reported as variants.
updates.audit_notes: The initial 2020 preprint record was reconciled to the accepted archival conference version.
previous_titles: Watching the world go by: Representation learning from unlabeled videos

records.normalized_title: parameter efficient multimodal transformers for video representation learning

updates.method_description: Modality-specific and shared low-rank Transformers learn masked embedding prediction and cross-modal pair prediction with content-aware negatives.
updates.audit_notes: The initial 2020 preprint record was reconciled to the accepted archival conference version.
previous_titles: Parameter efficient multimodal transformers for video representation learning

updates.method_description: Active gradient-embedding selection builds diverse and informative audio and video negative dictionaries for cross-modal contrastive learning.
updates.dataset_notes: UCF101 is used in the paper's small-scale active-selection analysis in addition to the large pretraining collections.
